_comment: SG13CMOS5L PDK pin fact sheet for this repo (issue #4). Read by scripts/setup-env.sh, which fails closed when these values disagree with the checksum-pinned klayout-tools fetch scripts or with the tarball it downloads. Every recorded result under sim/ and layout/ must trace to this file (or a later commit that bumps it).
release_tag_note: No IHP-Open-PDK release carries SG13CMOS5L (latest v0.3.0 predates the merge), so the pin is a dev-branch commit SHA plus the codeload tarball sha256. The standalone IHP-GmbH/ihp-sg13cmos5l repository was archived 2026-09-23 and is not used.
install_layout: pdks/ihp-open-pdk/ihp-sg13cmos5l (this tree) next to pdks/ihp-open-pdk/ihp-sg13g2 (sibling). PDK_ROOT=pdks/ihp-open-pdk PDK=ihp-sg13cmos5l. pdks/ is gitignored.

sibling._comment: The CMOS5L subtree's shared device models (psp103, r3_cmc, mosvar Verilog-A sources and cornerMOSlv.lib among others) are relative symlinks into a sibling ihp-sg13g2/ tree. Without it they dangle (klayout-tools#1406). The sibling is whatever scripts/fetch-ihp-sg13g2.sh installs.
sibling.known_incomplete: v0.3.0 predates the dev commit above, so 262 symlinks of the CMOS5L subtree dangle at this pin (klayout-tools#3133, closed as documented). The ones that matter: the moscap model libraries and the LVS cap_cmomi/cap_cmomf rule-deck includes (see layout/smoke/README.md). The LV MOS models and the Verilog-A sources used by the smoke simulation resolve.

fetch_method: klayout-tools scripts/fetch-ihp-sg13g2.sh then scripts/fetch-ihp-sg13cmos5l.sh, fetched by commit SHA and sha256-checked by scripts/setup-env.sh (see layout/toolchain.json for the klayout-tools commit and the script hashes).

osdi._comment: Prebuilt cap_cmomi/cap_cmomf OSDI were removed upstream (IHP-Open-PDK#1239/#1260): all six models are compiled from the PDK's Verilog-A with the PDK's own libs.tech/verilog-a/openvaf-compile-va.sh. Nothing under sim/ commits a .osdi binary.

runtime_compatibility: VERIFIED in this repo at this pin on linux-x86_64 / ngspice-47 / openvaf-r osdi_0.4-153-g2e066436: all six models compile and load in ngspice (devhelp), and the smoke inverter simulates at tt (sim/smoke/records/). Five-corner and fleet (batch) execution are NOT verified: the batch fleet publishes no ihp-sg13cmos5l image (supported: sky130A, gf180mcu, sg13g2).
